external_frame.model_advocacy_in_literature: STRONG and one-sided: the only dedicated paper is a photospheric/magnetisation paper whose entire physical result (eps_Th <= 0.5, reconnection vs internal shocks) rides on the sub-dominant BB being real, and two later papers (Chen+2024a,b) cite it as an exemplar of the thermal class. The HLE papers (Li&Zhang 2021, Tak 2023) fit no BB at all. This bias is disclosed here and must be restated in P3.

predictions: P-A (window-integrated shape, falsifiable): over our stamped window [-2.199, +27.404] s the AIC winner is a CURVED, high-energy-tailed family (Band / SBPL / DSBPL / Band+BB), with the continuum Ep (Band-family, no BB) in 280-420 keV - bracketing the multi-instrument consensus 345 +/- 20 keV and the archival 340.9 keV. FALSIFIED if the winner's Ep < 250 keV or > 500 keV, or if a bare PL wins by dAIC >= 10 (the catalog PL is redchisq 20.79 vs 1.36 - it is hopeless).

P-A2 (high-energy tail, falsifiable): beta is pinned near -2.25 (catalog) / -2.30 (Konus-Wind, to 18 MeV) / -2.54 (archival window-integrated), i.e. a real power-law tail measured with BGO + LLE. Predict Band (or SBPL/DSBPL) beats CPL by dAIC >= 10 window-integrated. FALSIFIED if CPL beats Band by dAIC >= 10.

P-B (BLACKBODY - the headline test, falsifiable): a refereed dedicated paper claims a significant sub-dominant BB with kT = 38.1 +/- 1.4 keV time-integrated and 30.6-36.1 keV in three sub-intervals (phi = F_BB/F_tot = 0.065 +/- 0.007). Predict the union rule (LRT_BANDBB_BAND >= 9.2 AND kT > 1.05 AND LRT_CPLBB_CPL >= 9.2) fires in >= 3 time-resolved blocks, with the firing kT values lying in 25-60 keV and DECLINING with time across the pulse. FALSIFIED if ZERO blocks fire (which would contradict a published, C-stat-111-unit detection and demand an explanation of the difference in detector set / binning / statistic), or if the firing kT values sit outside 20-70 keV, or if kT RISES monotonically.

P-B2 (BB seed-rail diagnostic, falsifiable as a procedure): the archival window-integrated fit returned LRT_CPLBB_CPL = 188.8 with kT = 38.6 keV while Band+BB railed at the kT floor (1.0000 +/- 0.013, VALID=False) and gave LRT = 1.12 - a textbook L8 default-seed artifact, not a null. Predict the hardened engine (L8 multistart) now returns a NON-railed Band+BB kT (>= 5 keV) for the window-integrated block and a Band+BB LRT >= 9.2 there. FALSIFIED if Band+BB again rails at the kT floor in the integrated block - which would mean the L8 fix does not cover this seed path.

P-C (two-break, falsifiable): the archival prior put DSBPL as the window-integrated AIC winner (dAIC = 9.8 below SBPL, LRT_DSBPL_SBPL = 13.81) with a LOW break xb = 144.6 keV and a peak xp = 339.4 keV - and the catalog's independent SBPL puts its single break at 182.6 +/- 5.9 keV, i.e. well below Ep. Predict DSBPL is within dAIC < 10 of the window-integrated winner and that, if it wins, its lower break xb falls in 80-220 keV. FALSIFIED if DSBPL loses to SBPL by dAIC >= 10 window-integrated, or if a winning DSBPL puts xb outside 80-220 keV. Any DSBPL win MUST first clear the L8 default-seed artifact check.

P-D (binning / temporal, falsifiable): Li & Zhang 2021 found 17 Bayesian-Block bins over -1 to 25 s (9 with S > 15 in the decay wing) with the SAME detectors we approved (their '(n0)n1n3b0'); Maccary+2025 give MVT = 0.893 (-0.231/+0.312) s and Npeaks = 3; the archival prior had 18 blocks over [-0.58, 26.84] s. Predict our block decomposition yields 10-25 significant blocks over the stamped window and an MVT-equivalent in 0.3-2.0 s. FALSIFIED by fewer than 6 blocks, or by an MVT outside that band.

P-E (Ep evolution / Type III, falsifiable): Li 2026 measures a POSITIVE Ep-flux lag of 2.16 +/- 0.76 s (Ep peaks AFTER the flux peak; P_III = 0.97) using 15 CPL bins, and the catalog's peak-slice Ep (356 keV at 9.2-10.2 s) is HARDER than the window-integrated Ep (346 keV). Predict our per-block Ep sequence peaks LATER than our per-block flux sequence (positive lag, >= 0 s at 1 sigma) and that Ep at the end of the window (t > 20 s) is at least a factor 2 below its maximum. FALSIFIED by a clearly NEGATIVE Ep-flux lag (Ep peaking >= 1 sigma before the flux) or by a flat Ep(t).

P-F (component coverage, falsifiable): the GBM catalog fluence window [-2.048, +31.744] s is almost exactly our stamped window [-2.199, +27.404] s. Predict our window-integrated 10-1000 keV energy fluence agrees with the catalog's 8.319e-05 erg/cm2 to within 20 percent, and comes out BELOW Konus-Wind's 1.21e-04 erg/cm2 (which is a wider band, 20 keV-10 MeV, and includes more of the tail). FALSIFIED by a >30 percent deviation from the catalog value at matched band - which would indicate a background or response problem, not physics.

P-G (LLE / high-energy validity, falsifiable): T_LLE,05/95 = 3.02/12.61 s, so LLE signal lives in the FIRST HALF of our window; the LAT photon index inside the GBM interval is very soft (-3.1 +/- 0.4) while the 11 GeV photon arrives at ~97.5 s, far outside the window (D4). Predict (i) LLE contributes significant counts only in blocks overlapping ~3-13 s, (ii) our joint high-energy slope over the window is STEEP (beta <= -2.2), and (iii) NO hard, LAT-like additional component (a rising nuFnu above ~10 MeV) is required inside the window. FALSIFIED if a hard extra high-energy component is preferred by dAIC >= 10 anywhere in the window - which would be a genuinely new result and would have to survive the EC-vs-max-LAT-photon validity gate.

P-H (background validity, falsifiable): our POST background windows open at +48 s (n0,n1,b0) and +60 s (n3,lle), while Konus-Wind reports 'a weak tail up to ~100 s' (20 keV-10 MeV) and the LAT extended emission runs to T_LAT,1 = 408.7 s. Predict the residual GBM tail at 48-140 s is BELOW the polynomial background noise, i.e. no coherent positive residual at the early edge of the post-window. FALSIFIED if the fitted background shows a systematic positive excess in the first ~15 s of any post-window - in which case the post window must be pushed later before any block flux is quoted, and every flux in the archival prior inherits a small over-subtraction.

P-I (HLE closure, falsifiable and deliberately three-sided): Li&Zhang 2021 say the decay satisfies alphahat >= betahat + 2 in both phases; the SAME paper says this burst violates its [F_nu,c, E_c] test; Tak+2023 grade the HLE evidence 'Weak'. Predict our own decay-phase test (t > t_p ~ 8.4-9.2 s) is AMBIGUOUS in the same way - i.e. the fitted temporal index is steep (alphahat > 3) but the Ep(t) decline is faster than pure curvature allows. FALSIFIED by a clean, unambiguous curvature signature (alphahat = 2 + betahat within 1 sigma AND an Ep(t) track matching the constant-Gamma HLE prediction), which would side with Li&Zhang against Tak and would be a reportable adjudication.
